title: REQ · Story panel class appears once in the composed layout
summary: StoryPanel root must not reuse the story-panel class owned by GameLayout
description: Context: GameLayout owns the story-panel container that the mobile drawer CSS targets; StoryPanel nests a second element with the same class. Desired behavior: StoryPanel root uses a distinct class (story-content) and GameLayout remains the sole story-panel owner. Expected result: mobile position: fixed and transform apply once. Why: avoid doubled drawer positioning.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout wrapping StoryPanel, when rendered, then document.querySelectorAll('.story-panel').length equals 1
Given StoryPanel rendered alone, when rendered, then its root element has class story-content and not story-panel
Given the drawer toggle clicked, when state is open, then the single .story-panel element has class drawer-open
technical_constraints: Do not edit styles.css rules for .story-panel
definition_of_done: One story-panel element in the composed layout
